ios.desc:
Bring the power of AI to Shortcuts! 

Get instant access to the power of AI with Smart AI Actions. This intuitive app lets you type in your questions and receive personalized responses in real-time. Whether you need help with a specific task or just want to learn something new, Smart AI Actions has you covered. 

Take your productivity to the next level - access popular AI APIs* and become a power user!

Integrated API Shortcuts include:
- Chat and legacy Completions
- Messages
- Edits
- Moderations
- Images Generations
- Models
- Tokenizer

Helpful text and template Shortcuts are also included.

Save and re-use prompts for OpenAI, Gemini, Copilot and other AI tools. Some examples prompts are also included. Prompts can support parameters/arguments as well.

* You may purchase access in the application or bring your own API key

This application is not associated with OpenAI or any of its products or services. It uses OpenAI as a date source. 

This application is not associated with Anthropic or any of its products or services. It uses Claude as a data source.
